parameters.note: After a purchase or a restore the phone asks the server this many times whether access is on (K-702): the store's webhook reaches the server seconds to a minute later. With subscription_confirm_interval_ms, about a minute; past it the screen says it can take a minute and offers to look again.
The wait between two of those questions.

The trial reminder (K-707) fires this many days before the trial ends: time to decide and cancel before the first charge. Asked for by the user's tap; a billing notice, not one of the three reminder kinds (ADR-036).

The trial reminder rings at this hour of the phone's own day (K-707 review): never at the hour the trial happened to start — a purchase at 01:30 would ring at 01:30. Mid-morning, when a billing choice can be made.
